description:
After 20 years of being the center of attention, Tae-hyuk feels frustrated on his first day at university.\
Ji-won, who is more perfect than Tae-hyuk in appearance, grades, and even personality, appears in front of him.

Tae-hyuk feels inferior to Ji-won in everything, and begins to openly antagonize him.\
Until one day, when he falls asleep drunk, he wakes up naked and finds Ji-won naked in the same bed as him.
